object_grain: one exact vector subject + one governed authority dimension + one complete governed component binding set
binding_law: component semantic ownership remains with exact producers; vector closure/projection authority may bind refs but may not reown component payload semantics

required_vector_subject.authority_dimension_contract_ref: ExactRef or exact immutable authority ref required

coverage_law.complete_coverage: every governed component identity has exactly one exact component binding and a resolvable typed authority state for the projected authority dimension
coverage_law.incomplete_coverage: any governed component identity is absent, unresolved as a binding, multiply/ambiguously bound, or otherwise not exactly dispositioned

nonempty_law.all_governed_components_nonempty: complete coverage and every governed component has authority_state=VALUE with one non-empty authoritative value binding

replay_oracle: same scalarization disposition and scalar value if lawful
negative_ceiling: This oracle specifies the minimum semantic test only; it does not install a production object family, select architecture, or authorize route-specific storage.
